_about: The Weapon/Gear Bonus Attributes section of the in-game Build-Making Database, as recorded on October 28, 2026 (Season 2 Phase 2). 'listed' is the database's own list in its order; 'descriptions' is each card's text, word for word. The database still lists the six Blast/Piercing/Shredding damage attributes and doesn't list All Weapon Damage or All Skill Damage. Evidence: research/build-database/bonus-attributes.json.
header: When you obtain a weapon or a gear piece, 2 different Bonus Attributes will be randomly generated for them.

descriptions.Weapon Critical Hit Chance: Weapon Critical Hit Chance Bonus granted from weapon hit.
descriptions.Weapon Critical Hit Damage: Bonus damage dealt by a weapon after a critical hit.
descriptions.Weapon Damage: Additional damage dealt by a weapon when it deals damage.
descriptions.Weapon Multi-Shot Chance: Represents the probability for weapon hits to generate an additional hit. This attribute's value can exceed 100%, with each additional 100% generating another hit.
descriptions.Headshot Damage: Bonus damage dealt by a weapon after a headshot.
descriptions.Weapon Blast Damage: The extent to which Blast Damage dealt by weapons is amplified.
descriptions.Weapon Piercing Damage: The extent to which Piercing Damage dealt by weapons is amplified.
descriptions.Weapon Shredding Damage: The extent to which Shredding Damage dealt by weapons is amplified.
descriptions.Max Health: The extent to which Health is increased. A character is downed when their Health reaches 0.
descriptions.Armor: The amount of bonus Armor. The higher the Agent's Armor, the more Defense they have.
descriptions.Damage Reduction: Represents the incoming damage reduced from Weapon Damage or Skill Damage. Damage Reduction above 80% will not be applied.
descriptions.Skill Critical Chance: The chance of skills dealing a critical hit.
descriptions.Skill Critical Damage: Bonus damage dealt by a skill after a critical hit.
descriptions.Skill Intensity: The extent to which a skill's effect is enhanced.
descriptions.Skill Multi-Shot Chance: The chance for skills to deal damage an additional time. Whenever this attribute exceeds 100%, skills deal an extra instance of damage.
descriptions.Skill Duration: The extent to which Skill Duration is increased.
descriptions.Skill Radius: The extent to which Skill Radius is expanded.
descriptions.Skill Cooldown Recovery: The extent to which Skill Cooldown is reduced.
descriptions.Skill Blast Damage: The extent to which Blast Damage dealt by skills is amplified.
descriptions.Skill Piercing Damage: The extent to which Piercing Damage dealt by skills is amplified.
descriptions.Skill Shredding Damage: The extent to which Shredding Damage dealt by skills is amplified.
descriptions.Received Healing: The extent to which Health is increased when healed by Skills or Medical Kits.
descriptions.Damage to Elites: Damage Bonus when dealing damage to Elite Enemies.
descriptions.Signature Ability Charge Efficiency: The extent to which Signature Ability Charge efficiency is accelerated.
